text:
alex: Quick sync — planning a timed surge swap for EU->APAC at 2025-03-24 10:00 UTC. Goal is a short, controlled shift (10% -> 60% in 5m steps). Who's owning the deploy?
maya: I can own the deploy window and smoke checks. I'll be online 09:30–11:00 UTC. :white_check_mark:
liam: I'll handle routing policy changes and DNS TTL updates. I'll prepare the route weights and a rollback knob.
jordan: I'll run health probes and watch latency dashboards. Can someone confirm KV prefix cache priming is disabled for this window? We want cold-start behaviour measured.
azarel: small nit: my calendar shows a conflict at 10:15 UTC — I can be on-call backup starting 10:30 if needed.
alex: @zara thanks — noted. maya, liam — plan is:
- 09:45 UTC: final preflight checks (runbook + smoke scripts)
- 10:00 UTC: step 1 -> 10% APAC
- 10:05 UTC: monitor 5m, step 2 -> 30%
- 10:10 UTC: monitor 5m, step 3 -> 60%
- 10:20 UTC: stabilize; finalize config
maya: Copied. I'll post /runbook checklist in thread and run the smoke script. Quick checklist:
1) Canary deploy to staging passed
2) Canary to edge-staging passed
3) Alerting hooks set
4) Rollback playbook at hand
I'll paste smoke command:
```
./scripts/smoke_check.sh --region apac --routes sample
curl -sS https://internal-monitor/api/health | jq .
```
liam: Routing changes: I'll apply weighted policy via router API and lower DNS TTL to 30s at 09:50 UTC. Rollback plan: set weights back to baseline and raise TTL to previous value. I'll create the router change snippet now:
```
PATCH /v1/routing/policy
{ "region_weights": {"eu": 40, "apac": 60} }
```
zara: Deploy-bot scheduled a deploy job: job id 20250324-1042. Noted that jobs are queued if capacity low.
deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy window created by alex at 2025-03-24T09:30:00Z, job=20250324-1042, sla-window=90m.
jordan: Smoke probes to run on these endpoints:
- /v1/generate (p50/p95 latency)
- /v1/health
- sampling of 100 requests through router
I'll track errors >= 1% and p95 spiking > 2x baseline as triggers to pause.
maya: I'll open the canary ticket in ops board and post results after each step. If anything looks off I'll call rollback. Who is authorized to trigger rollback? alex: Either maya or liam can trigger rollback; if both unreachable, jordan can execute.
liam: Quick QA: confirm we've pinned model variant to quantized-v2 for APAC to reduce memory OOM risk? alex: yes pinned in the deployment manifest. manifest snippet:
```
model_variant: "quantized-v2"
max_seq: 1024
```
zara: FYI I'll be monitoring the console and can flip the fallback policy if we see model errors.
maya: All good from my side. I'll start preflight at 09:45 UTC and post status updates here. :rocket:
alex: Thanks all — keep updates short. If you post daily summary, put it in #eng-platform-ops-log. I'll be pinging infra to keep an eye on capacity.
